packageRules.description: mix.exs keeps its semver ranges; mix.lock is the pin. config:best-practices pins exact versions, which suits a manifest that may have no lockfile - mix.exs always has one, so an `==` requirement there is redundant and turns every patch release into a hand edit.

Hold TypeScript below 7. @docusaurus/tsconfig 3.10.2 sets `baseUrl`, which TS 7 removed (TS5102), so `npm run typecheck` cannot pass on 7.x - and not from this repo's side, since the option comes from the inherited config. Drop this rule when Docusaurus ships a TS7-compatible tsconfig.
